title: CBHF 0.1.0 recommended actions
description: Schema for handoff/recommended-actions.json. ActionStatus is pending|blocked|cancelled only — never completed. Export-time suggestions remain pending. related_ids reference other package ids (e.g. q_*, unk_*, cfl_*); existence is Validator-stage.

priority.description: Priority label. No closed enum is defined in CBHF 0.1.0 docs (example uses high).

status.description: pending | blocked | cancelled. Do not mark export-time suggestions as completed; ActionStatus has no completed value.

related_ids.description: Loose references to related package object ids (questions, unknowns, conflicts, etc.).
